RetroAchievements RAHasher
===========================

OmniLibrary can download the official RAHasher 1.8.3 utility on demand from
the RetroAchievements RALibretro release. RAHasher is not embedded in the
Tools for Steam source tree or installer.

Project: https://github.com/RetroAchievements/RALibretro
Release asset:
https://github.com/RetroAchievements/RALibretro/releases/download/1.8.3/RAHasher-x64-Windows-1.8.3.zip
Expected archive SHA-256:
d79be62a6d6a4b938c71fb2e7534fe3e1802ee7d97411fde2ee10b8e330dd93c
License: GNU General Public License v3.0
License text and corresponding source:
https://github.com/RetroAchievements/RALibretro/tree/1.8.3

RAHasher calculates the platform-specific content hash used by
RetroAchievements. OmniLibrary caches only the resulting hash-to-game mapping;
it does not upload or redistribute the user's ROM file.
